verdicts.title: Boolean lattices in finite alternating and symmetric groups
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Given a group $G$ and a subgroup $H$, we let $\mathcal{O}_G(H)$ denote the lattice of subgroups of $G$ containing $H$. This paper provides a classification of the subgroups $H$ of $G$ such that $\mathcal{O}_{G}(H)$ is Boolean of rank at least $3$, when $G$ is a finite alternating or symmetric group.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns 'lattice of subgroups' that are 'Boolean of rank at least 3' in alternating and symmetric groups, which shares only the word 'Boolean' with the conjecture and has no bearing on circuit monotone width or Alexander-Dirac invariants.
